sections.fullText: Join The SevaDeep Sponsor A Meal Program

paragraphs: 194 million Indians are undernourished, and our country is ranked 94th out of 107 countries in the Global Hunger Index, a measurement of the world’s hunger and malnutrition levels. According to the GHI report, 14 per cent of India’s population is undernourished. It also says that the country recorded a child stunting rate of 37.4 per cent.

The country lockdown during spread of the COVID pandemic made food sourcing even more difficult for thousands of people. It caused a food shortage across the nation, disrupting local, regional, and national food supply chains.

As a quick response to this urgent matter, SevaDeep launched Narayan Seva, a specialized, dedicated food service that provides free meals to the underprivileged masses. Narayan Seva, our long-distance food delivery program, delivers food to those in need, especially in distant regions, labor camps and chall areas.

“We made sure we make food accessible to everyone in need during these tough times. The food is cooked in the SevaDeep kitchen and we follow all the safety measures outlined by the authorities.”, says Nitin, SevaDeep’s Head of Operations.

The Sponsor a Meal Program would not be possible without the support of hundreds of people who opened their hearts and donated to the cause. A simple donation of Rs. 3,000 helps us feed 200 people. Thousands have already benefited from the program and its popularity is only growing. Reports of food shortages land in our system on a daily basis and we can only cope with the requirements with your support.
In case you’d like to know more about the program, or you are interested in making a donation, visit the Sponsor a Meal Program page on our website.

Remember that there are hundreds of other NGOs that could use your support in other forms. The NGO near you could benefit from your donation of old clothes, furniture, appliances, toys or books. Check out our list of NGO requirements here.
Thanks to your support, we have onboarded over 420 NGOs till date and have completed over 1,500 donations. Spread the word and help us bridge the gap between more donors and NGOs.
Be sure to follow us on Facebook for more news and updates on our work.
